containerVersion.name: Add GA4 gab_widget_open tag, trigger, and variable
containerVersion.description:
Tags:
* Added a new "GA4 — gab_widget_open" tag (Google Analytics: GA4 Event) with measurement ID G-40ZLLXSRFY and event name "gab_widget_open", triggered by "CE — gab_widget_open".

Triggers:
* Added the "CE — gab_widget_open" custom event trigger, which fires on the event "gab_widget_open".

Variables:
* Added the "DLV - trigger" Data Layer Variable for "trigger".
